# Advanced options {#advanced-options}

Reuse configuration and extend the build with scripts.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`extends`](./extends.md) | Inherit configuration from other sections or build environments |
| [`extra_scripts`](./extra-scripts.md) | A list of PRE and POST extra scripts |
